limitations: Concept-story and selected mechanical/layout checks only. No game, collision, native palette or sprite-animation certification.
Empty staging, unused papers and open routes do not submit quest states, consent, rescue or ending outcomes.
Inventory refresh covers all PNG files; it is not visual approval of unreviewed files.

findings.finding: The dry rectangular outer ring is visually continuous around the central pit. Two opposed accessible lever stations, two empty carrier troughs, a closed book retained on a fixed rear-left pedestal and two stair exits are visible. No guard, captive, corpse, victory emblem or selected ending is shown. This is empty environment staging: the empty troughs cannot establish rescue, defeated threats or absent forced carriers in the actual N17 encounter. Apparatus capacity, branch independence and exit traversal require implementation; blue mineral deposits are inert decoration, not an unlimited crystal power source.

Mechanical shutoff bench and wooden confirmation/record desk are physically separated. Closed ledger, separate unused stamp, locked drawer and broad unobstructed foreground stairs are visible; no explicit chosen ending, signed agreement or final-commit mark appears. Slate and small packet have decorative unreadable markings, so unsigned status and operation instructions cannot be certified from pixels. The closed side partition is not evidence that the threat has already been cleared; physical safety and final governance confirmation must remain separately gated.

Several empty public cubbies coexist with three occupied packet stacks; lower double-door compartment is shut and padlocked. No readable private names or compulsory gathering is depicted, and the foreground public path remains open. A small strapped chest substitutes for the requested closed register. Empty slots are suitable for missing replies, but packet presence cannot certify actual receipt, fulfilment, forgiveness or a particular N17 snapshot. The riverside arrangement is a new local concept, not evidence that any bridge has been repaired.

Four seated poses retain Mara’s rust scarf, ochre dress, cream apron and brown hair from the reviewed reference; no Ivo/reunion or celebration is added. Hand positions vary, but the strand topology is not a demonstrable right-over-center/left-over-center sequence: loose ends change count and routing, the braided length shifts discontinuously and the fourth pose lacks clearly separated short working ends. Basket/stool placement and scale drift slightly; separate rope rest is omitted. Suitable only as quiet rope-working storyboard, not as four mechanically continuous weaving frames. N18 appearance still follows N1 state; this sheet cannot imply Ivo’s release or an already resolved personal case.

overall: 71–73 usable as state-neutral environment review concepts; 74 needs strand-continuity redesign before animation.
